grounded.observation: Current host snapshots and visibility-filtered objects; integer tiles; six inventory slots.
grounded.structure_alive: For structures objectAlive means exposed; positive HP means standing.

predicates.inventory_has_empty: An empty slot was seen during the earlier inventory scan.
predicates.no_candidate: No candidate was observed; no assertion about unseen enemies.

situation.notes: Published a6112c5 runtime. No selfAttackCooldown or selfAttacksLanded API; timed stationary bursts are an explicitly uncertain inference.

grounded.lifetime: BASIC globals start at zero per episode and persist across decisions and respawns. join_wave revalidates an escort by observed living ID whenever selected.
grounded.uncertainty: Unseen enemies are unobserved. Tower targets and enemy intentions are not exposed.

B_wave.claim: Using an observed allied footman as the no-target movement anchor may increase productive lane presence and fort wins. This is not evidence that a footman shields a hero from towers.

B_equipment.claim: Matched hosted games: sustain-only won 4/10 versus v1 2/10. Final equipment totaled 35 versus 16. These observations inform the equipment-saving hypothesis; broader strength remains unresolved.

B_kite.claim: Completed 40-case local screen: 2 wins versus v2 7 and default 2; deaths 92 versus v2 78; basic-hit events 817 versus 862. Preregistered screen failed. Live-field superiority unestablished.

B_kite_timing.claim: Replay-observed basic hit within18ticks before 70/77 normal retreats; displacement observed in 27/40 games. Tile timing remains an imperfect inference. All120 complete action/state replays verified.

G_fort.preference: Team fort victory is the terminal evaluation objective. Timeouts score zero.

G_base.preference: Keep v2 nearest-enemy target selection; change only execution of combat into burst kiting.

G_capacity.preference: Keep baseline healing and mana support while preserving gold for persistent equipment growth. Stop buying poison in this isolated economy experiment.

G_wave.preference: When no observed target exists, retain v2 allied-wave following. Combat execution is specified separately by G_kite.

G_kite.preference: Preserve heroes by attacking in bursts and retreating from close threats, with a low-health escape. Death reduction must retain fort-win performance and actual attack output.

G_glory.preference: Track lifetime-XP-minus-duration Glory on fort wins as a secondary measure; preserving fort wins and reducing deaths gates kiting changes.
